# Juan Fernandez

> AI Pipeline Engineer based in Santiago, Chile. Builds production AI agents, multi-agent systems and LLM pipelines, and the full-stack apps around them. Ingeniero de pipelines de IA en Santiago, Chile.

Also known as: Juan Fernández, @7uanF (X, Instagram, TikTok), Z1Code (GitHub).
About page: https://7uanf.com/about (English) · https://7uanf.com/sobre-mi (español)

## Profile

- Role: AI Pipeline Engineer at a YC-backed startup (stealth), building a 0-to-1 product on an agent architecture.
- Before: Web Team Leader / AI at Globant. Led a team of 8 engineers and architected production multi-agent systems (delegation patterns, persistent memory, LLMs wired to real tools through function calling and MCP).
- Location: Santiago, Chile. Works remotely.
- Languages: Spanish, English.
- Focus: AI agents, multi-agent systems, LLM pipelines, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Claude, GPT, Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL.
- AI content creator on X (@7uanF). AI companies hire him to show their products doing real work: viktor, Gamma, Luma AI, Replit, Modulate, Replay, Pollo.ai, Skygen and Matrix OS.

## Selected work

- iCopy: complete, verified iCloud Photos backup for Windows. His most popular open-source project (100+ GitHub stars). https://github.com/Z1Code/iCopy
- SOS Venezuela 2026: civic platform online less than 7 hours after the M7.2 and M7.5 earthquakes in Venezuela (June 24, 2026). Live damage map, missing-persons directory and a public API. Code: https://github.com/Z1Code/sosvenezuela2026
- PokeScan: Pokémon TCG price radar across 14,000+ cards, updated daily.
- APR Transports: website and dispatch panel for a US freight carrier.
- gcp-oauth-automator: automates Google OAuth 2.0 client creation in GCP with Playwright. https://github.com/Z1Code/gcp-oauth-automator
- More projects: https://7uanf.com/#projects
